title: cotoneaster integerrimus var. nummularius
intro: Cotoneaster integerrimus var. nummularius, commonly known as Silver Cotoneaster, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Silver Cotoneaster include analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic effects, which can help in reducing pain, fever, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
